page_title: PIS 1-0 CRE | Pisa v Cremonese 07/11/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+5' Gabriele Piccinini (Pisa) gives the referee no choice but to show him a yellow card.
90+1' Alberto Gilardino has decided to substitute M'Bala Nzola and he is replaced by Henrik Meister (Pisa).
90+1' We are about to witness a substitution. Dennis Johnsen (Cremonese) is replacing Filippo Terracciano.
90' 4 additional min. will be played.
87' Surely that's handball by one of the Pisa players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
85' Romano Floriani (Cremonese) tries to find the head of a teammate in the box but overhits the cross. The ball goes out of play and Pisa will have a goal kick.
83' Marius Marin (Pisa) violates the laws of the game and is shown a deserved yellow card by the referee.

79' The ball falls kindly for Simone Canestrelli (Pisa) inside the box and he goes for goal. It's a decent effort but flies just over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Cremonese will have a goal kick.
78' Filippo Terracciano (Cremonese) receives a yellow card from the referee as expected.
78' M'Bala Nzola (Pisa) jumps for a cross in the goal area and produces a fine header which goes narrowly wide of the left post! What a huge opportunity!
77' The referee allows time for a substitution. Franco Vazquez will be replaced by Romano Floriani (Cremonese).
77' The manager has been forced to make a substitution and the injured Mikayil Faye (Cremonese) limps off the pitch to be replaced by Federico Bonazzoli.
77' A substitution has been made. Martin Payero is replaced by Jeremy Sarmiento (Cremonese).

75' 1 - 0 Goal! Matteo Tramoni hands Idrissa Toure (Pisa) the simplest of tasks from close range after the cross evaded the keeper, and he makes no mistake with his header into the right side of the goal. 1:0.
74' Matteo Tramoni (Pisa) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man.
74' Matteo Tramoni (Pisa) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. The ball is out of play. Pisa win a corner kick.
72' Jari Vandeputte (Cremonese) overhits the corner kick and none of his teammates can their head on it.

71' What a great chance for Federico Baschirotto (Cremonese). He times his jump superbly when he leaps high to meet a precise cross from the corner, directing his towering header right under the bar, but the goalkeeper denies him with a miraculous save. Cremonese have a corner.
71' Jari Vandeputte (Cremonese) steps up to send the ball in.

70' Jamie Vardy (Cremonese) fashions a shot from the edge of the box after receiving an accurate pass. Adrian Semper makes a comfortable save to stop the effort from flying into the middle of the goal.
69' The ball goes out of play and Pisa will have a goal kick. Franco Vazquez picks out Warren Bondo (Cremonese), who drives a shot just wide of the right post from the edge of the box.
68' That's the end of the game for Ebenezer Akinsanmiro, who is replaced by Gabriele Piccinini (Pisa).
67' Alberto Gilardino decides to make a substitution. Isak Vural will be replaced by Marius Marin (Pisa).
67' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Stefano Moreo leaves the pitch and Matteo Tramoni (Pisa) comes on.
67' Isak Vural (Pisa) sends in a lofted cross from a mid-range free kick. His effort, however, goes out of play.
66' Ebenezer Akinsanmiro (Pisa) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
65' Poor challenge! Franco Vazquez (Cremonese) is penalised for tripping and Matteo Marcenaro blows his whistle. Another situation results in a direct free kick for Pisa.
63' Franco Vazquez (Cremonese) rises highest from the corner and heads at goal, but his effort towards the bottom right corner is saved by Adrian Semper.
62' The referee awards a corner and Jari Vandeputte (Cremonese) goes over to take it.

62' Tommaso Barbieri (Cremonese) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it. The referee signals a corner kick to Cremonese.

61' OFF THE CROSSBAR! Franco Vazquez (Cremonese) runs towards the goal to give his teammate support. He receives a fantastic pass and shoots from the edge of the box, but it crashes against the crossbar. It could have been a brilliant goal, unlucky.
60' Antonio Caracciolo (Pisa) peeled away from his marker and got on the end of the corner, but his fine header towards the right post is brilliantly saved by the diving goalkeeper.
60' Mehdi Pascal Marcel Leris (Pisa) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.

59' M'Bala Nzola (Pisa) picks up a cross inside the box and unleashes a quick shot towards the right side of the goal. His promising effort is kept out by Emil Audero, who pulls off a stunning save! It will be a corner kick for Pisa.
57' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Mikayil Faye (Cremonese).
56' Some great controlled play and passing from Cremonese. They are increasing their possession of the ball and trying to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
55' Jari Vandeputte (Cremonese) sprays a pass out to Franco Vazquez, but he can't beat his man to get to the ball. The ball is out of play. Cremonese will take a throw-in.
53' That's a well-taken pass by M'Bala Nzola (Pisa). He unleashes a strike from the edge of the box, but blazes it high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Cremonese.

51' Stefano Moreo (Pisa) wins the ball inside the goal area from the resulting set piece and unleashes a shot which sails high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Cremonese will have a goal kick.
51' Matteo Marcenaro blows the whistle, Federico Baschirotto (Cremonese) is penalised for a foul. Pisa are awarded a free kick from a dangerous position.
49' Surely that's handball by one of the Cremonese players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
49' Matteo Marcenaro couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Martin Payero (Cremonese) and blew his whistle.
48' Isak Vural (Pisa) makes a bad tackle on his opponent and is angry when the referee shows him a deserved yellow card.
48' Substitution. Mikayil Faye makes way for Federico Bonazzoli (Cremonese).
46' Warren Bondo (Cremonese) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Matteo Marcenaro no option but to blow his whistle.
46' The teams are back out for the second half and here is a change on the pitch. Alberto Gilardino gives a chance to Mehdi Pascal Marcel Leris and Juan Cuadrado (Pisa) is off.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+2' Matteo Marcenaro has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45' The fourth official shows 1 min. of added time.
43' Mikayil Faye (Cremonese) collects a pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender.
43' Stefano Moreo (Pisa) commits a rough foul. Matteo Marcenaro stops the game and makes a call. There is a free kick near the sideline to Cremonese.
41' The corner from Juan Cuadrado (Pisa) is intercepted by Emil Audero.
40' The resulting corner from Juan Cuadrado (Pisa) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Pisa.
40' Idrissa Toure (Pisa) connects with the free kick and produces a header goalwards which is well blocked. The goalkeeper doesn't have to worry about that one. Pisa have been awarded a corner kick.
39' Mikayil Faye (Cremonese) is given a fully deserved yellow card.
39' Jamie Vardy (Cremonese) is flagged for offside.
37' Franco Vazquez (Cremonese) covers his face with his hands after wasting a promising chance. He takes the rebound on the edge of the box but blazes the ball high over the crossbar.
36' Jari Vandeputte (Cremonese) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts.
36' Warren Bondo (Cremonese) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Cremonese.
33' There's a melee in the box, but the referee isn't interested in the appeals from Cremonese for a penalty. Play continues.
33' Jari Vandeputte (Cremonese) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players.
32' The resulting set piece, sent into the penalty area by Juan Cuadrado (Pisa), was easily dealt with by one of the defenders.
31' The referee blows his whistle as Warren Bondo (Cremonese) was too aggressive in his challenge. Pisa are awarded the free kick.
29' Filippo Terracciano (Cremonese) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
28' Jamie Vardy (Cremonese) attempts to find Franco Vazquez with a delicate little through ball from inside the box, but one of the defending players makes a timely intervention.
27' Matteo Marcenaro interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Federico Baschirotto (Cremonese).
26' A goal, which was scored by M'Bala Nzola (Pisa), was disallowed due to offside.

24' Ebenezer Akinsanmiro (Pisa) meets a pass on the edge of the penalty area and shoots towards the bottom right corner. He didn't put enough power into the effort, though, and Emil Audero pulls off an easy save.
23' Juan Cuadrado (Pisa) attempts to find Idrissa Toure, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Cremonese.
23' Martin Payero (Cremonese) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.

22' Antonio Caracciolo (Pisa) leaps highest in the penalty area to get on the end of a cross from the set piece, and he produces a promising goal-bound header towards the middle of the goal, but Emil Audero pulls off a comfortable save to deny him.
21' Tommaso Barbieri (Cremonese) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Matteo Marcenaro has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle. That's a free kick to Pisa.
18' Warren Bondo (Cremonese) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
18' Warren Bondo (Cremonese) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
17' Michel Aebischer (Pisa) receives a yellow card from the referee, but it seems like a very harsh decision.
15' Franco Vazquez (Cremonese) has a shot blocked, it rebounds back to him, but even on his second attempt he cannot hit the target. His effort goes well wide.
15' Jari Vandeputte (Cremonese) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.

14' The goalkeeper dives to deny Franco Vazquez (Cremonese), whose promising shot was aimed towards the left post. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Cremonese will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
14' Idrissa Toure (Pisa) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
13' Arturo Calabresi (Pisa) is penalised for holding. Matteo Marcenaro signals a set piece.

10' Emil Audero makes a good save! M'Bala Nzola (Pisa) easily weaves through the defence and unleashes a low shot from long range. His effort is directed towards the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper is alert and stops it.
9' Mikayil Faye (Cremonese) sends in a lofted cross from a mid-range free kick, but his poor effort goes out of play. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Pisa.
8' Michel Aebischer (Pisa) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Matteo Marcenaro blows his whistle for an infringement. Cremonese earn a free kick.
7' Juan Cuadrado (Pisa) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
5' Good defending. Filippo Terracciano (Cremonese) tries to find Jamie Vardy inside the box, but the pass is cut out.
4' Idrissa Toure (Pisa) crosses the ball forward but it is intercepted.
3' A lofted pass into the box is met by Idrissa Toure (Pisa), who rifles a shot just over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Cremonese will have a goal kick.
2' The linesman signals that M'Bala Nzola (Pisa) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
1' The match has just started.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Cremonese will have the kick-off.
Matteo Marcenaro will referee today's match.
Show lineups Both teams starting lineups are available now, so you can have a look at them.
